2. `root>panel` - positioned at y=40, z-index: 2, height 60px (covers y=40 to y=100)

The glass div (z-index: 1) does cover the text area (y=0 to y≈19), but critically, its `background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` means it's completely transparent. A transparent overlay doesn't obscure text readability.

The screenshot confirms the text "Still readable" is clearly visible at the top, above both overlays.
